methodology.panel_anchor: production _selection_anchor semantics (10 templates, scales (0.85,0.9,1.0,1.1,1.15,1.2), ROI (0.20,0.45,0.80,0.80), threshold min(0.70, match_threshold))
methodology.first_full: first frame of contiguous anchor-present run (5fps window)
methodology.input_evidence: cursor (48x48 cursor_tpl grayscale TM_CCOEFF_NORMED) in card zone (x 350-1350, y 150-650) or button row (x 400-1100, y 500-680) within 2 frames before a content change >=250k px or panel close
methodology.latency: input_t - first_full_t (5fps = 0.2s resolution; input click lies within the 0.2s before the observed change frame)
methodology.quality_STRONG: cursor evidence + big content change or close observed
methodology.quality_MEDIUM: short run (<=0.4s) with cursor evidence; resolution floor
methodology.insufficient_evidence: panel visible but no in-zone cursor before close / no visible close
methodology.frame_time_mapping: idx 1fps frame k <-> video time t = k-1 s; 5fps window frame f <-> t = window_start + (f-1)*0.2 s
methodology.window_crop: game window (78,63)-(1671,963) resized to 1600x900 for anchor/cursor analysis (same as production capture path)

disconnect_evidence.scan_details: idx_a 2778 + idx_b 2569 frames (1fps, full 1920x1080) + legacy rec dirs 986 frames; gameDisconnect + retryConnect templates, threshold 0.70, scale 1.0; C:/tmp/perf_scan_disconnect_results.json + C:/tmp/perf_scan_legacy_results.json
disconnect_evidence.conclusion: no disconnect modal frame exists in available material; fixture class marked missing (consistent with repo fixtures/manifest.json missing_disconnect_modal)
